You're close to hitting your 5 monthly runs on the free plan. Before you do, I wanted to flag what opens up with Starter at A$19/month — you get enough runs to keep your job search moving without the monthly reset stress.

The core of Aether stays the same: sourcing from licensed APIs (nothing older than 30 days), fit scoring that explains why roles match, resume tailoring grounded in your real history with an anti-fabrication guard, and a human approval queue before anything ships out. Gmail triage handles inbox noise across all plans.

Starter just removes the ceiling, so you're not rationing runs or waiting for the calendar to flip.

If you want to stay on free, that's fine — but if your search is picking up pace, it's worth the swap.
